skill.summary: Read, write, search, append, patch, and manage notes in any Obsidian vault via the Local REST API on Windows, macOS, or Linux.

latestVersion.changelog: v1.1.0: real-world pitfalls from deployment — trailing slash requirement on directory endpoints, correct root endpoint is / only (not /api/healthz), shell variable expansion caveat with exec tool, output formatting rules (never dump raw JSON), improved troubleshooting with 40400 root cause and fix
